messages:
sam_sales: Heads-up — Northstar (prospect) wants to run a 6-week POC next month. Requirements: 1) retain audit logs for 7 years, 2) customer-managed keys (KMS) with HSM-backed key storage, 3) HIPAA + SOC2 support. They asked for a pricing sketch and whether we can fast-track an attestation.

jordan_se: Thx. Quick sketch below — needs deal-desk signoff for any non-standard SKUs. POC estimate and add-ons:```
POC (6 weeks, hosted): $18,000 (credits + support)
Audit-log retention (7yr): $1,200/mo per TB (tiered discount at volume)
KMS + HSM bundle: $2,500/mo + $9,000 one-time setup (HSM attestation kit)
HIPAA compliance package: $3,000/mo
SOC2 continuous monitoring add-on: $1,000/mo
```

sam_sales: Can we offer any one-time discount for an enterprise commit? customer is asking about a 12mo purchase if POC looks good.

maya_finance: If they commit to a 12mo minimum we can apply a 12% contract discount across hosted usage and add-ons. One-time setup fees (HSM attestation) are negotiable down to $6k with an annual commitment and a signed SOW.

ash_security: From security side — need to confirm key separation model and that HSM keys never leave HSM. Also want to know if audit logs can be exported to customer S3 (with SSE-KMS) and retained immutable for 7 years. We can do WORM-style retention; requires legal + infra signoff.

elaine_legal: I need the proposed contract language for KMS responsibilities and evidence of HSM attestation. Also we should include a data-retention addendum for the 7-year log retention and a clause about export rights and deletion timing. I can draft but need the exact SKU names and whether logs are redacted by default.

jordan_se: Logs are full by default, can apply redaction pipeline before export. SKU names for quoting: "POC-6W-HOST", "AUDIT-7YR-1TB", "KMS-HSM-BUNDLE", "COMPLIANCE-HIPAA", "COMPLIANCE-SOC2".

deal_desk_bot: @sam_sales — request received. Please attach proposed customer POC SOW and expected ARR if converted. Tagging @elaine_legal for contract review. Threshold flags: discounts >10% require VP approval.

sam_sales: Adding numbers — expected if converted: $220k ARR (12mo). Attaching rough SOW in thread (link: https://share.company/sow/northstar-poc).

maya_finance: With a 12% concession the fiscal impact is acceptable; pre-approve up to 12% discount. Anything beyond needs VP-Sales.

elaine_legal: I can draft the retention addendum and KMS responsibilities today. For the HSM attestation we can supply our SOC/attestation package and coordinate a 3rd-party attestation if they require it — 4-6 week lead. If they need faster, consider a contractual interim statement plus the full attestation later.

ash_security: Confirmed: we support S3 export (SSE-KMS) and WORM retention. Will prepare a short technical note for the customer describing encryption, key lifecycle, and HSM guarantees.

northstar_cto: Appreciate the transparency. Two asks from our side: 1) Can we get a firm timeline for the HSM attestation? 2) Is the 7yr retention priced per TB or per log stream? Also prefer keys to be in our cloud account (bring-your-own-key).

jordan_se: Timeline: standard attestation 4-6 weeks; expedited option (paid) 2-3 weeks if we allocate dedicated audit resources and pay the $9k setup. Pricing is per TB of stored audit data; we can set retention policies per stream but billing follows aggregate TB. BYOK: yes, supported — we’ll document the flow and responsibilities.

sam_sales: Next steps: 1) @deal_desk_bot — please initiate approval for a 12% discount cap for this deal and flag VP-Sales if pushed. 2) @elaine_legal — draft retention/KMS addendum and interim attestation language. 3) @ash_security & @jordan_se — write technical note for customer. 4) @northstar_cto — confirm if they want expedited attestation (we’ll include expedited cost).

deal_desk_bot: Done — approval ticket #DD-4917 opened. ETA for review: 24h.

elaine_legal: Will draft and push in the ticket.

jordan_se: I'll draft the tech note and attach a sample command for S3 export and KMS config:```
# S3 export example (customer S3 with SSE-KMS)
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-audit-export/ northstar-audit/ --recursive --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/abcd
```

sam_sales: Great — keeping this thread as the single source for approvals. Will update after deal-desk response. :thumbsup:
